target_reader: readers who want strong serialized hooks and clear protagonist agency
one_sentence_promise: Draft strategic promise; must be landed from the opening experiment before drafting.
main_story_question: Draft main story question; must be landed before drafting.
protagonist_long_term_desire: Draft protagonist desire; must be landed before drafting.
core_opposition: Draft opposition; must be landed before drafting.
worldview_reveal_strategy: Reveal rules through scene pressure, not encyclopedia exposition.
opening_hook: Draft opening hook; must be landed before drafting.
emotional_hook: Draft emotional hook; must be landed before drafting.
differentiation_angle: Pilot first, then expand by gate evidence.

volume_plan.volume_function: Validate hook, protagonist agency, and reader pull.
volume_plan.start_state: Opening state is pending the core freeze.
volume_plan.end_state: Gate A/B evidence determines whether to expand.
promises_to_pay_off: First three chapters must validate the premise.
questions_not_to_solve_early: Do not solve the central rule before brief authorization.

major_character_arcs: Draft character arc; must be landed before drafting.
main_thread_plan: Draft main thread plan; must be landed before drafting.
relationship_thread_plan: Draft relationship thread plan; must be landed before drafting.
power_or_rule_progression: Rules are authorized by brief and confirmed by shipped events only.
risk_and_cost_progression: Progress must create visible cost or aftermath obligations.
first_3_chapters_validation: There is a concrete reason to continue.
first_10_chapters_validation: The first volume has sustained mainline pull.

gate_plan.B: After 10 shipped chapters, check first-volume traction.
gate_plan.C: After 25 shipped chapters, update volume structure.
gate_plan.F: At 200 chapters, govern state indexes and foreshadowing ledger.
gate_plan.G: At 500 chapters, govern repetition, setting debt, and long-thread payoff.
gate_plan.H: At 800 chapters, govern endgame and restrict new long-term mechanisms.

ending_direction: Draft ending direction; must be landed before drafting.
open_questions: Long-run details stay open until gate evidence supports them.
anti_imitation_attestation: This outline does not copy protected plots, settings, relationships, phrases, or distinctive narrative voice.
